entries.ee47566faa8c1de5: This is a single business engaged in the design, fabrication and on-site construction of steel structures such as steel frames. The company does not conduct businesses other than construction, and does not state segment information. Completed construction revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥24,219 million. Design and cost estimation work is handled by the subsidiary Kawagishi Planning Co., Ltd. Steel structures are produced at the Chiba First and Chiba Third plants (Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture), the Osaka plant (Habikino, Osaka Prefecture), the Okayama plant (Kasaoka, Okayama Prefecture) and the Yamaguchi plant (Kudamatsu, Yamaguchi Prefecture).
